serde_format: serde_json (the ONLY serde format in the ay workspace: no bincode, messagepack, cbor or postcard dependency or call site exists)
host: aarch64-apple-darwin (64-bit BigDigit; see the cfg_digit note in the module docs)

encode.name: bigint/zero
encode.note: sign NoSign (0) and an EMPTY limb vector

encode.name: bigint/one
encode.note: smallest positive; limb vector [1]

encode.name: bigint/neg_one
encode.note: SIGN CARRIER: differs from bigint/one only in the sign field

encode.name: bigint/u32_max
encode.note: exactly fills one base-2^32 limb; the 64-bit hi word is zero and is OMITTED

encode.name: bigint/two_pow_32
encode.note: first value needing a second base-2^32 limb: [0, 1]

encode.name: bigint/two_pow_64_minus_1
encode.note: LIMB STRADDLE (2^64 - 1): both u32 words of the sole 64-bit limb are nonzero

encode.name: bigint/two_pow_64
encode.note: LIMB STRADDLE (2^64): a second 64-bit limb opens; hi word of it is zero and OMITTED

encode.name: bigint/two_pow_64_plus_1
encode.note: LIMB STRADDLE (2^64 + 1)

encode.name: bigint/neg_two_pow_64
encode.note: SIGN CARRIER at the limb boundary: -(2^64)

encode.name: bigint/i64_min
encode.note: SIGN CARRIER: -2^63, the value a two's-complement codec most often mishandles

encode.name: bigint/two_pow_128_plus_1
encode.note: INTERIOR ZERO limbs: a codec that trims zeros anywhere but the tail breaks here

encode.name: bigint/large_positive
encode.note: multi-limb ordinary magnitude

encode.name: bigint/large_negative
encode.note: SIGN CARRIER: negation of bigint/large_positive; only the sign field differs

encode.name: bigrational/zero
encode.note: 0/1 — denominator is 1, NOT 0, and the numerator's sign is NoSign

encode.name: bigrational/neg_numer
encode.note: SIGN CARRIER: -3/4, sign rides the NUMERATOR

encode.name: bigrational/neg_denom_normalized
encode.note: constructed 3/-4 via Ratio::new, which REDUCES and moves the sign to the numerator

encode.name: bigrational/neg_denom_raw
encode.note: DENORMALIZED via Ratio::new_raw: the denominator really is negative on the wire

encode.name: bigrational/unreduced_raw
encode.note: UNREDUCED via Ratio::new_raw: 2/4 is stored as 2/4, not 1/2

encode.name: bigrational/multilimb
encode.note: both members straddle the limb boundary

encode.name: farkas/empty
encode.note: empty coefficient vector — the degenerate annotation

encode.name: farkas/neg_numer
encode.note: SIGN CARRIER: -3/4

encode.name: farkas/neg_denom_normalized
encode.note: 3/-4 via Ratio::new — REDUCES, sign moves to the numerator

encode.name: farkas/neg_denom_raw
encode.note: DENORMALIZED via Ratio::new_raw: negative denominator survives to the wire

encode.name: farkas/unreduced_raw
encode.note: UNREDUCED via Ratio::new_raw: 2/4 stays 2/4

encode.name: farkas/i64_extremes
encode.note: SIGN CARRIER: i64::MIN numerator and i64::MAX denominator, unreduced

encode.name: farkas/realistic_vector
encode.note: a plausible Farkas certificate: several coefficients, mixed signs
encode.raw: coefficients=[numer=1 denom=1, numer=-3 denom=4, numer=0 denom=1, numer=7 denom=2]

encode.name: constant/bool_true
encode.note: externally tagged newtype variant

encode.name: constant/string
encode.note: externally tagged newtype variant carrying a String

encode.name: constant/int_neg
encode.note: SIGN CARRIER inside the enum tag

encode.name: constant/rational_neg_denom_raw
encode.note: RationalWrapper is a newtype struct and is TRANSPARENT: no extra nesting

encode.name: constant/bitvec_zero_width8
encode.note: STRUCT VARIANT: named fields `value` and `width`, in declaration order

encode.name: constant/bitvec_straddle_width65
encode.note: STRUCT VARIANT at the limb boundary

decode.name: decode/bigint/nosign_with_limbs
decode.note: NON-CANONICAL: sign 0 with a nonempty limb vector. from_biguint CLEARS the limbs.

decode.name: decode/bigint/plus_with_empty_limbs
decode.note: NON-CANONICAL: sign 1 with no limbs. from_biguint DEMOTES the sign to 0.

decode.name: decode/bigint/trailing_zero_limb
decode.note: NON-CANONICAL: a trailing zero limb is trimmed, so re-encoding differs from input.

decode.name: decode/bigint/bad_sign
decode.note: INVALID: sign outside {-1,0,1} must be REJECTED, not clamped.

outcome.message_contains: invalid value: integer `2`, expected a sign of -1, 0, or 1

decode.name: decode/bigint/limb_overflows_u32
decode.note: INVALID: limbs are u32; a value above u32::MAX must be REJECTED.

decode.name: decode/rational/unreduced_preserved
decode.note: The decoder uses Ratio::new_raw and does NOT reduce: 2/4 stays 2/4.

decode.name: decode/rational/zero_denominator
decode.note: INVALID: a zero denominator must be REJECTED.

outcome.message_contains: invalid value: integer `0`, expected a ratio with non-zero denominator

decode.name: decode/bitvec/unknown_field
decode.note: deny_unknown_fields is on the struct variant: an extra key must be REJECTED.

decode.name: decode/farkas/unreduced_preserved
decode.note: Ratio<i64> decode does NOT reduce either: 2/4 stays 2/4.

decode.name: decode/farkas/neg_denom_preserved
decode.note: A negative denominator survives decode unchanged; no sign migration.

decode.name: decode/farkas/zero_denominator
decode.note: INVALID: zero denominator must be REJECTED.

outcome.message_contains: invalid value: integer `0`, expected a ratio with non-zero denominator

decode.name: decode/farkas/unknown_field
decode.note: deny_unknown_fields on FarkasAnnotation: an extra key must be REJECTED.
